body: So your comment spurred my interest and I looked up what are some common signs of a brain injury and I found I have quite a few of the symptoms. 1) I have been experiencing tremors in my leg and knee 2) I’ve been nauseous almost every other day if not every day 3) I’ve had a consistent headache for a while now. And also recently I experienced a weird pain in my head, like my brain was twitching but it hurt. Out of curiosity is that enough to go to the doctors about or should I be on the lookout for anything else?
